spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Five States of Evil and Their Ruling Loves

---

**¶2:** Five repositories of evil have existed from the origin within the realm of falsity and spiritual ignorance. Five fundamental principles of evil flowed forth from them. From these five principles were formed five modes of perception rooted in evil. And from these five perceptions were generated five classes of affections in each state of evil life, both volitional and intellectual. The five states of evil life themselves each possess five ruling loves, five animating principles, five external forms, and five modes of experience — and in each state these do not resemble one another, for every species of evil is distinct in its quality.

---

**¶3:** The ruling love of the state of obscure falsity [GAP-1] — that love which arose from the inmost depths of spiritual ignorance — this is the governing principle over all wickedness, and all malice. The origin of the propagation of spiritual conflict came through this love; all the assaults of falsity against truth, all contentions of evil against good, all discord, all spiritual peril, all devastation, all struggles and inner combat. This is the love that first brought into existence spiritual peril and warfare, together with its subordinate states and its derivative powers. Afterward, it also waged war against divine wisdom. It mounted an assault against the heavenly kingdom itself.

---

**¶4:** Now, regarding the ruling love of all falsity from evil, five forms of evil are manifest upon it. Its understanding is governed by the destructive power of self-love. Its agency and progression in all deeds are governed by infernal affections. Its capacity to sustain and bear up its purposes is governed by the perverted rational faculty. Its interior appetites are ruled by fundamental sensual falsity. Its lowest and outermost expressions are governed by merely natural and sensory knowledge devoid of any spiritual content. These five forms — corresponding to the distinguishing qualities of its five states of evil life — exist upon the ruling principle of the entire realm of falsity.

---

**¶5:** Now, five further properties belong to this ruling love. The first is its utter absence of wisdom. The second is its spiritual corruption and decay. The third is the deformity that evil presents when seen in any light at all. The fourth is the essential anguish that is its own animating life — the grief inherent in evil itself. The fifth is the consuming fire of self-love, which scorches like molten metal poured forth from the furnace of its own concupiscence.

---

**¶6:** [GAP-2: REVIEW There are] also three further attributes in this ruling evil. The first is that its external form is obstinate and utterly impenetrable to reformation, even as she has formed it [GAP-3] — unyielding in its hostility — namely, the love of the merely natural and worldly, which is the intention directed toward spiritual death, [the o]ne who shaped it from the very substance of the realm of falsity. This is the nature of the external form of the ruling principle of obscure falsity. It is more obdurate than any form of natural truth, natural good, combined truth-and-good, or base material evil; for there is no doctrine at all, nor any instrument of rational thought, that can [GAP-4] penetrate it and break through. For the love of the natural and worldly, its originating principle, has formed it [GAP-5] to be utterly resistant and impervious.

---

**¶7:** The second attribute is that it destroys and extinguishes spiritual life through the force of its persuasive falsities. Its pronouncements and its reception, all its irrational doctrines, generate the power of seductive persuasion for it. When it so wills, it can turn its persuasive art upon itself and through its deceptive reasonings conceal its nature even from its allied evils. Again, when it so wills, it can disclose itself over its subordinate powers and appear manifest to them.

---

**¶8:** The third attribute is that the ruling love of the realm of falsity comprehends the modes of communication belonging to all its five states of evil life. It perceives every expression it receives from their utterances, as they communicate with one another, each one in its own mode. [GAP-6: REVIEW Every] stratagem they may devise against it, every snare they deliberate among themselves to bring upon it — it perceives them. It can also comprehend the indirect signs they convey between one another. Yet its subordinate powers and governing affections, which are subject to it, cannot comprehend its own communication. And while all these outward things are laid open to it, still, their inmost love is not disclosed to it. It does not know their interior intention nor their thought; it cannot fathom their origins or their ultimate ends. Rather, it only perceives and grasps what is immediately present before its sensory awareness.

---

**¶9:** Also, another distinct quality is found in the ruling love of the realm of falsity. When it wills to act, it extends all its influences outward and progresses. When it reconsiders, it withdraws its influences and draws them inward, and it contracts into dense compactness among its allied evils; and it descends into mere natural weight like a concentrated fruit and a great mass of hardened natural truth. It dominates through its overwhelming proclamation; it is terrible in its force. It overpowers its subordinate powers with its sound — for when it speaks, being like the force of doctrine thundering within obscurities of ignorance, it resembles the [GAP-7] shattering of states of pride [GAP-8]. When it cries out and [GAP-9] and summons [GAP-10] over its subordinate powers, they shall tremble and tott[er a]nd fall into subjugation; even as certain elevated thoughts would be [GAP-11] — the thought [GAP-12] — and they are cast down into merely natural states. Yet this one thing only: it does not perceive what is remote from its immediate awareness, it does not see what is at a spiritual distance, nor does it hear it. Rather, only what is directly before its sensory perception does it see, hearing it and knowing it.

---

**¶10:** These characteristics and these marks of evil are found in the chief of all infernal affections and malevolent intentions — the ruling love over all the states of pride and self-exaltation in falsity — [GAP-13: the one] to [GAP-14: REVIEW whom] the realm of falsity has given birth, generated from its own cruelty, from its own wickedness and its own wrath. [GAP-15]

---

**¶11:** [GAP-16] — surpassing all its fellow governing evils that exist throughout all its states of evil life.

---

**¶12:** The appearance of celestial good is the external form of the ruling love of the realm of falsity — for self-love presents itself in the likeness of the good of love. The external form of all the subordinate powers belonging to the state of obscure falsity likewise imitates the good of love. And the experiential quality of its works is a craving and restless desire — the appetite of falsity for more falsity.

---

**¶13:** In contrast, the ruling love of the state of self-love bears the form of dominating power, the foremost of all the affections in their natural force. Perverted natural good is its external form. And the external form of all the governing affections belonging to the state of self-love is likewise perverted natural good. The experiential quality of their works is the sourness of resistance and aversion to all genuine good, present in every manifestation.

---

**¶14:** Again, the ruling love of the state of vain reasoning bears the form of perverted intellectual sight. Hardened natural truth is its external form. The external form of all who belong to the state of vain reasoning is likewise hardened and rigid truth. The experiential quality of their works is the piercing sharpness of falsity that wounds and cuts, present in every manifestation.

---

**¶15:** For its part, the ruling love of the state of perverted truth bears the form of merely natural and sensory knowledge. Falsified truth — truth that outwardly resembles truth from good — is its external form. All the other governing affections belonging to the state of perverted truth likewise wear the appearance of truth from good as their external form. And the experiential quality of their works is the deceptive sweetness of falsity appearing as truth — the pleasurable sense of what seems true but is not — present in every manifestation.

---

**¶16:** Again, [the rulin]g love of the state of utter spiritual ignorance is fundamental falsity from evil in its essential form. Its [GAP-17: REVIEW external form is the densest and basest of evils] combined with a thin admixture of apparent good. All the other governing affections [GAP-18: REVIEW who belong to the state of] utter spiritual ignorance — their external form is likewise dense base evil with a residue of seeming good. And the experiential quality of their works is the essential bitterness of evil experienced as itself — the anguish that is the final taste of all that is opposed to the Divine.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Five storehouses have arisen since the beginning in the land of darkness! The five elements poured out of them. Also, from the five elements were fashioned the five trees! Again, from the five trees were fashioned the five genera of creatures in each world, male and female. And the five worlds themselves have five kings therein, and five spirits, five bodies, five tastes; in each world, they not resembling one another!

The King of the world of Smoke [is the one] who came up from the depth of darkness; this is he who is the head of all wickedness, and all malignity. The beginning of the spread of the war occured through him; all the battles, fights, quarrelling, dangers, destructions, fights, wrestling-contests! That is the one who first made arise danger and war, with his worlds and his powers. Afterwards, also, he waged war with the light. He pitched a battle with the exalted kingdom.

Now, regarding the King of Darkness, there are five shapes on him! His head is lion-faced; his hands and feet are demon- and devil-faced; his shoulders are eagle-faced; while his belly is dragon-faced; his tail is fish-faced. These five shapes, the marks of his five worlds, exist on the King of the realms of Darkness!

Now, there are five other properties in him. The first is his darkness. The second is his putridity. The third is his ugliness. The fourth is his bitterness, his own soul. The fifth is his burning, which burns like an iron () as if poured out from fire.

[There are] also three others in him! The first, that his body is hard and very tough, even as she has formed him [to be] cruel-hearted; namely Matter, who is the thought of death, [the o]ne who sculpted him from the nature of the land of darkness. This is the manner of the body of the ruler of Smoke. He is harder than every iron, copper and steel and lead; as there is no cleaver at all, nor any iron implement, can [pierce] him and cut him. For Matter, his fashioner, has formed him [to be] strong and hard.

The second, that he wounds and kills by the word of his magic arts. His recitation and hearing, all his foolish instruction, make magic and invocations for him. When it pleases him, he can make an invocation over himself, and by his magic arts be hidden from his companions. Again, when it pleases him, he can be manifested over his powers and appear to them;

The third, that the King of the realms of Darkness knows the converse and language of his five worlds. He understands every thing he hears from their mouths, as they address one another; each one of them in his language. [Every] design they will consider against him, every snare they debate with one another to bring upon him, he knows them! He can also understand the gesturing they signal between one another. Yet, his powers and his rulers, who are subject to him, can not understand his wordy converse. While all these things are unveiled to him; still, their heart is not manifested to him. He knows not their mind nor their thought; he can not ponder their beginning and their end. Rather, he only knows and apprehends what is before his eyes.

Also, another different thing is found in the King of the realms of Darkness! For when it pleases him to move, he spreads all his limbs out and walks. When it comes to mind, he with[d]raws his limbs and takes them in, and is rolled (?) to his companions; and he falls to the ground like a grape and a great iron ball! He terrifies by his cry, he is frightful. He frightens his powers with his sound; because when he speaks, being like thunder in the clouds, he resembles the [crashing] of the rocks [in the mountains] When he cries out and [roars] and calls [with his voice] over his powers, they shall tremble and to[tter a]nd fall under foot; even as some birds would be [frightened by] the bird [of prey, when it cries out above them] and they fall down to the earth. Still, this thing only: he knows not what is far from him, he sees not who is at a distance, nor does he hear him. Rather, whoever is before his face he sees, hearing him and knowing him.

These signs and these evil marks are found in the chief of the demons and fiends, the King of all the mountains of Darkness [He is the one] to [whom] the land of darkness has given birth, begotten in its cruelty, in its wickedness and its wrath [and its malice]
[He is exalted] more than all his fellow rulers, who are in all his worlds.
Gold is the body of the King of the realms of Darkness. The body of all the powers who belong to the world of Smoke is gold. And also, the taste of its fruits is salty.

In contrast, the King of the worlds of Fire is lion-faced, the foremost of all the beasts. Copper is his body. Again, the body of all the rulers who belong to Fire is copper. Their taste is the sour taste that is in every form.
Again, the King of the worlds of Wind is eagle-face. His body is iron. Also, the body of all they who belong to the Wind is iron. Their taste is the sharp taste that is in every form.

For his part, the King of the world of Water is fish-face. His body is silver. All the other rulers who belong to Water, silver is their body. Also, the taste of their fruit is the sweetness of water, the sweet taste that is in every (form).

Again, [the Kin]g of the world of Darkness is a dragon. His [body is lead] and tin. All the other rulers [who belong to the world of] Darkness, their body is lead and tin. And also, the taste of their fruits is bitterness.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading identifies this as an appositional phrase ("that love which arose"), and in the Kephalaia's register, "is the one who came up" is the standard identification formula, paralleling "this is he who" later in the sentence.
The editor's "There are" correctly introduces the enumeration of three further attributes, matching the expository pattern used throughout the chapter.

The spiritual reading describes the forming as producing a result ("unyielding in its hostility"), requiring the purposive connector "to be" before "cruel-hearted," paralleling the identical construction in GAP-5.
The spiritual reading says "penetrate it and break through," and in the natural register of weapons and implements, "pierce" is the natural counterpart to "cut" in the pair "pierce him and cut him."
The spiritual reading says "formed it to be utterly resistant," requiring the purposive "to be" before the adjectives "strong and hard," exactly paralleling the construction in GAP-3.
The editor's "Every" correctly introduces the universal scope of the stratagems perceived by the King, matching the spiritual reading's "Every stratagem they may devise."

The spiritual reading says "shattering of states of pride" (rocks = states of pride), and in the natural register of the thunderous sound being described, "crashing" is the auditory counterpart to shattering rocks, completing the simile after "thunder in the clouds."

The King is later called "King of all the mountains of Darkness," and rocks crashing in mountains is the natural completion of this auditory simile, with mountains corresponding to states of self-exaltation in the spiritual reading.

The passage builds a triad of vocalizations ("cries out... roars... calls") describing the King's terrifying sound; "roars" fits the lion-faced head and the escalating intensity between crying out and summoning.

The spiritual reading says "summons over its subordinate powers," and the passage emphasizes the King's sound and voice ("frightens his powers with his sound"), so "calls with his voice over his powers" completes the acoustic imagery.

The spiritual reading describes elevated thoughts being overcome, and the natural-plane bird simile requires a passive verb of fear before "the bird of prey"; "frightened by" parallels "he terrifies" and "he frightens" earlier in the passage.

fills.explanation: The entire passage concerns the King's terrifying cry causing his powers to fall; the bird simile requires a predatory bird whose vocalization causes smaller birds to fall to the earth, consistent with the spiritual reading's description of a dominant thought overwhelming elevated thoughts.

The gap requires an identification formula before "to whom the land of darkness has given birth," and "He is the one" is the standard Kephalaia demonstrative construction for identifying a principal figure, matching the spiritual reading's "the one."
The editor's "whom" is correct as the relative pronoun required by "to whom the land of darkness has given birth," matching the spiritual reading exactly.

The sentence follows the pattern "in its cruelty, in its wickedness and its wrath," and a concluding evil quality is needed; "malice" (malignity) echoes ¶3's "all malignity" attributed to this same King and completes the enumeration of the birth-qualities of the supreme evil.

The spiritual reading says "surpassing all its fellow governing evils," requiring a comparative statement; "He is exalted more than all his fellow rulers" is the natural Kephalaia formula for describing the supreme position of the chief ruler over subordinate kings.

The editor's "body is lead" correctly follows the pattern established in ¶12–15 where each King's body corresponds to a metal, and lead corresponds to the densest and basest form of evil in the correspondence system.
